record.question: Which of the following clients is at the greatest risk for developing pressure ulcers?
options: An obese client who relies on a wheelchair.
A 79-year-old malnourished client who is on bed rest.
An incontinent client who has experienced three episodes of diarrhea.
record.explanation: Answer C: A 79-year-old malnourished client who is on bed rest.. Immobility, older age, malnutrition, and reduced tissue tolerance combine to place the bedbound malnourished older adult at highest pressure-injury risk. Reference: https://www.npiap.com/page/PressureInjuryStages. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
